items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (Multiple Vulnerabilities)
items.summary: This bulletin addresses seven vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) and multiple high-severity cross-site scripting and authorization flaws.

items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to switch a customer session to another customer account, gaining access to private data. Exploitation attempts were detected shortly after disclosure.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This bulletin addresses critical and important vulnerabilities that could result in security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, application denial-of-service, privilege escalation, arbitrary code execution, and arbitrary file system read.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw allowing attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution. Amasty released a fix in version 4.0.0.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer that allows remote code execution via a crafted cookie. Mirasvit released a patched version 1.11.12.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Commerce that enables remote, unauthenticated attackers to bypass security measures and gain unauthorized write access.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento's REST API
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API allowing unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files by disguising code as an image (polyglot) to bypass validation. Adobe released a fix in Magento 2.4.9.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Privilege Escalation in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.
